title: Audit remaining local (l-prefix) short IDs after server-assign migration
description:
After PR #657 (server-assign player + lookedAt short IDs), most objects should get server-assigned p-prefix IDs. Once we have 10+ games on harness epoch 27, audit the LLM JSONL logs to see if anything is still getting l-prefix local IDs. If so, investigate each case and determine whether server assignment is feasible.

Look for l-prefix IDs in:
- GAME_TARGET choice lists (player targets should now be p-prefix)
- Fact or Fiction / lookedAt card choices (should now be p-prefix)
- Any other tool results

Search pattern: grep for '"l[0-9]' in *_llm.jsonl files from epoch 27+ games.
